question: 工作点 A (单卡高配) 中 P_card_high 的具体价格区间与波动性：NVIDIA H100 SXM5 80GB 当前现货均价为 $25,000-$30,000 (2024Q3-Q4), H200 80GB 为 $35,000-$40,000 [时效待核]。若考虑租赁替代购买，H100 小时租金约为 $2.0-$3.5/hour，年运行 8760h 的等效成本为 $17,520-$30,660，低于一次性购买+折旧成本 [待核验：最新云服务商定价]

sources.title: How Much Does an NVIDIA H100 GPU Cost in 2026?
sources.snippet: As of March 2026, the NVIDIA H100 GPU price for a single 80GB PCIe unit starts at approximately $25,000 USD and climbs to $30,000-$33,000 depending on vendor, region, and availability; the higher-bandwidth SXM5 variant typically costs $35,000-$40,000+ per GPU 1.
